commission.source_quote: The Platform shall retain a commission of twenty percent (20%) of the Gross Order Value, being the list value of the goods before any promotional discount.

delivery_fee.source_quote: No delivery partner fee applies to this agreement.

hold.source_quote: The Seller's share shall become payable upon confirmation of delivery. No additional hold period applies.

promotion_funding.source_quote: Discounts shall be funded 25% by the Platform and 75% by the Seller.

provenance.notes: SYNTHETIC contract corpus — not a real merchant agreement.

refund.source_quote: The Seller payout for an order shall be reversed prior to any refund being issued to the customer. Commission retained by the Platform is non-refundable. Reversal shall be completed within 72 hours.

tax.source_quote: The Platform shall withhold tax at source at one percent (1%) of the commission amount.
